name: cortico-world-self-checkup
author: zaocan

zh.description: 她最近是跑得慢了，还是心思变了？先别急着重装，做一次「鱼鱼体检」。① 运行健康：六维雷达图看稳定性、速度、缓存、上下文、交接与记忆，自带各插件 Token 消耗环形饼图与记忆插件实时监测，谁最烧 Token、哪段记忆在漏一眼看清；② 心理健康：专属小鱼插画名片、口语化性格侧写、近期常聊话题与娱乐小本本，陪你重新认识她；③ 隔离深度体检：独立合成测试检验上下文保持、指令遵循与会话内事实更新，不写入主会话、不污染记忆。日常只读不改配置，明暗主题跟着 Coo 走。

en.description: Running slower or acting different lately? Run a Fish Checkup before reinstalling. Operational Health gives a 6-axis radar chart, per-plugin token donut breakdown, and live memory plugin status; Wellbeing crafts an illustrated personality card, recent topics, and curiosity quiz; Isolated Deep Checkup tests context retention, instruction following, and in-session updates without touching real memory. Read-only by default and follows Coo's light/dark theme.
